evidence: A green HTTP candidate served sauna and its gate passed; progress then halted at grading, 'Gondolin grading room is not implemented', with no file-verdicts or file-score instead of passing with 11 recorded effects.
After R-1 failed at the fence, starting R-1 for C-2 returned run-already-started; the list showed R-1 once for C-1.
During R-1’s sleeping builder, start R-2 returned -32000 run-in-progress, R-2 progress was null and R-1 progress was running.
A gate-passing R-1 halted at grading instead of concluding passed, so the required passed-cycle setup could not be established; a subsequent R-2 for C-1 was nevertheless refused cycle-already-run.
Started R-1 with the syntactically valid nonexistent deadbeef commit; start returned -32000 not-a-commit and run-progress returned null, with no builder launch.
With an empty feature, start then progress showed checklist refused empty-checklist and the run halted at checklist before self-check or fence.
Added an unstamped third scenario: stamp recorded 01-001 through 01-003, then progress showed halt at stamp for differing identities and no pin or checklist.
Self-check exited 1 with golden checklist differs; progress showed the cycle failed at fence for harness-self-check-failed with that detail, with self-check last and no fence or regenerate.
Self-check printed SKIP bb-tools and exited 0; its passed event listed bb-tools, and the effect detail named it.
Fenced impl and absent harness/cycles: fence was refused fenced-path-matched-nothing, followed by recorded fail-cycle; progress failed at fence for fence-refused without regenerate.
Fenced existing impl and harness/cycles; the builder logged an empty impl, plan and config in the object listing, one commit, and no impl or harness/cycles object path.

The red-then-green HTTP fixture produced two recorded builder sessions with different attempt-suffixed identities; regenerate completed before the failed gate and subsequent repair launch, and attempt 2 passed the gate.
The builder left a candidate and exited 1; regenerate recorded its digest and the HTTP gate passed, but the run halted at grading rather than passing with its cycle.
The builder exited 0 without producing files; progress showed no regenerate effect, a recorded fail-cycle, and failure at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated.
The builder slept 30 seconds with regenerate timeout 2; it was stopped, no regenerate event was recorded, and progress failed at regenerate for budget.
Held the configured HTTP port open; attempt 1 recorded three seam-answered-before-boot refusals, each followed by gate-refusal, and failed at gate for infrastructure. The launch marker was absent.
With one HTTP attempt, a red suite and a launch script that would create a marker, the gate recorded suite-red; no launch marker appeared and the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.
With one allowed HTTP attempt and a builder-produced executable test.sh but no start.sh, gate-attempt-failed was recorded for contract-missing.
A green HTTP suite served a page without sauna, with one attempt; the gate recorded identity-probe-failed with detail page lacks marker.

The builder started a delayed write that changed its suite to red after exit; the installed copy passed its HTTP gate and its digest equalled regenerate's, while the builder room's suite had changed to exit 1.

After the first red suite, the repair event named the first failed gate's evidence root and verification-repair; the second builder saw previous-candidate and gate-evidence, and attempts to write into each returned permission denied.

The builder made red suites for all three attempts; its log showed exactly three sessions, the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted, no grader model call occurred, and no file-verdicts effect appeared.

With the researcher scripted to fail on 01-002, the command gate passed but the runner halted at grading before any researcher call; neither file-verdicts nor file-score was recorded, so the requested one scored and one unreached result did not occur.

On one store R-1 failed at the fence and R-2 halted at the empty checklist; later readings five seconds apart retained those statuses and their effect results matched the readings just after each start.
Two progress queries for the same gate-passing run were identical, but that run had halted at unimplemented grading instead of passing, so the required still-passed Then did not hold.
The probe accepted only the full configured URL and a marker-bearing page, and the gate passed; the run then halted at grading rather than passing with its cycle.
The candidate's HTTP suite created and removed a directory under impl; the gate passed and install's candidate digest matched regenerate's.
The self-check printed the full legacy SKIP line; the passed event's skipped-checks and effect detail contained the whole text after SKIP.

With a green stdio suite, passing probe and store check, gate recorded a pass with 30 seconds, one poll, and the expected probe line; the run halted at grading with 'Gondolin grading room is not implemented' instead of passing.

The stdio probe recorded its two arguments: the gate-room impl/start.sh absolute path and 30; its only store variable was GATE_STORE under the evidence directory outside the gate room. The store check received that exact path.

With one allowed attempt the stdio suite recorded its environment and exited 1; the gate recorded suite-red, the environment had neither GATE_STORE nor LOYLY_ variables, and neither probe nor store-check log appeared.
A green stdio suite and a probe exiting 1 with the specified 30-second message yielded gate-attempt-failed identity-probe-failed with that message; the store check was not run.
With a passing stdio probe and a failing store check, gate recorded identity-probe-failed with the store-check line, and the one-attempt cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.
A stdio suite tested for plan/01-a/spec.feature from its working directory; gate passed and the install and regenerate digests were identical.
With passing stdio suite and probe but an empty store-check command, run-progress showed halted at gate for effect-could-not-run and no gate effect result.
Two stdio runs on one store used the same probe and config but store-check command suffixes one and two; both first self-checks passed and carried different harness digests.
The 01-a symlink was stamped and the checklist named 01-001 and 01-002 with 01-a sources, but the run subsequently halted at grading instead of not halting.
With two slices and PLAN_SLICES=02, progress showed a single stamp for 02-001 and a checklist containing only 02-001.
With builder-clojure configured, both sessions logged its image path as third argument; the regenerate and repair effect details named builder-clojure and the same image digest.
Configured missing builder image with an empty images directory: start returned -32000 builder-image-missing and progress returned null.

Two successive gate-passing runs shared one store and the second stamp recorded no new identities, but both halted at grading and the scoreboard query for C-2 returned null instead of reporting C-1 as previous.
The cut's harness/probe.sh read harness/config.sh relative to itself and checked the marker in the HTTP page; the gate passed and regenerate and install carried the same digest.

The command logged one call in the project repo with the cut tree without impl, the separate candidate copy and an initially empty evidence directory; the pass event recorded 20 polls, 10 seconds, poll 3 and ledger answered as itself, with the copied candidate digest matching install and no candidate launch marker.

The gate command wrote receipt and returned suite-red 3 of 65 tests failed on attempt 1; the event preserved that reason and detail, the repair builder saw the receipt read-only, and attempt 2's gate passed.
The command printed BOOT 20 10 and seam-answered-before-boot then exited 1: progress showed three refused gates each followed by a recorded gate-refusal, and failed at gate for infrastructure.
The command printed BOOT 20 10 and infrastructure the world did not come up, then exited 2; progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run and that detail, with no gate, fail-cycle, or cycle.

Three HTTP runs with no gate command, gate-a, and gate-b all passed their gates and their self-checks carried three distinct digests; the first matched SHA-256 of config bytes, the self-check command text, then probe bytes.

The green HTTP run's Grain store passed the reference check for its recorded effects and showed cycle.v1 and a gate-attempt child, but the run halted at grading and recorded only nine effects, not the required passing run and eleven leaves.
A server returned HTTP 503 to its first three requests; gate recorded a 10-second, 20-poll pass on poll 5. The regeneration-cycle progress query showed boot-margin-polls 15.

The first HTTP suite failed and the second gate passed; the Grain reference reader found two successful gate-attempt.v1 runs. The parent run halted at unimplemented grading instead of passing with its cycle.
Started a detached copy of the candidate against a fixture repo; its HTTP gate passed, but the run halted at grading with 'Gondolin grading room is not implemented' instead of passing.

With the judge scripted for booked/pass and no receipt/fail, the gate passed but the runner halted at grading without scores, verdicts or score. The Grain reader showed only cycle.v1 and one gate-attempt child tick, and no grade.v1 ticks or judge scores.
The researcher stub was set up to return E-ONE for the first item, but the gate-passing run halted at grading before any researcher or judge request, so no first-item judge request contained E-ONE.
The researcher stub was set up to call vm_bash for its directory and files; after a passing gate the runner halted at grading before sending any researcher request or opening a grading-room shell.

With the judge scripted to omit reasoning for 01-002, the gate passed but the run halted before any judge request; progress had no scores and the Grain reader found no judge score events, so neither 01-001’s score nor the requested unreached measurement was filed.
Approved only r-1, not the computed rubric digest; progress halted at grader with refused-before-the-cycle and the actual sha256 digest, before self-check, fence or builder.

With the model scripted to reject all researcher requests, the gate passed but the runner halted at grading before calling it; neither the zero-verdicts refusal nor fail-score-stage was recorded, and the run did not fail with its cycle.

Killed the runner and sleeping builder five seconds into the first session, then restarted on the same store; the builder saw the same session identity twice and progress retained one pre-gate effect each, but after the gate passed the run halted at unimplemented grading rather than passing.

The render stub returned INSTRUCTION-7; the first copied instruction was exactly that text, while the repair's copied instruction added only a paragraph naming previous-candidate and gate-evidence, both read-only.
With an unreachable model endpoint, render failed after the fence; progress halted at render for effect-could-not-run and had no regenerate effect.
While the builder slept, run-progress showed a tick id with running status, completed fence then render, and regenerate as the final running node.
